text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: Dedicated pool 'eu-west-1-prod-ded' is seeing sustained p99 streaming latency > 5s and elevated queue depth. Auto-scale events triggered but warmup lagging. Please triage. thread:1987654321

maria: I'm on it. seeing p95 ~900ms, p99 peeked at 5.4s for the last 6m. Queue depth trending up from 120 -> 900 in 10m. Removing non-critical bursts now.

raj: pulling autoscaler logs. initial observation: scale-up started at 1987654280, handshake delays between scheduler and pool nodes ~30-90s each. Warmup tasks (model init) hanging on some instances.

lucy: any streaming-specific stalls? or is this generic generation latency?

maria: streaming stalls — clients report partial frames then stall until reconnect. looks like kv-cache coldlines + model init under load.

raj: paste logs from autoscaler:
```
[1987654285] scale_event: target_instances=25 current=10
[1987654302] handshake_start -> waiting for slot init
[1987654328] init_shard(13): model_load_time=48s, nv_link_wait=1.2s
[1987654335] init_shard(14): oom? retrying init
[1987654350] handshake_complete for shard13
```

raj: several inits hitting 40-50s which pushes effective capacity up much later than expected. looks like underlying instance image coldstart + model quant table rebuild.

sam: can we trigger cold-warm pool prewarm? or move to a smaller quantized fallback?

maria: immediate mitigations we can do now: 1) enable fallback model variant (quantized v2) for streaming routes 2) divert traffic to eu-central standby region 3) bump pool manually (provision a few prewarmed nodes) 4) apply temporary rate-limit per-tenant for high-volume tenants. need owners for each.

lucy: i can flip routing to fallback variant via feature flag. will do a quick canary (5% -> 50%) and watch p99.

maria: sam, can you open a cloud escalation for faster instance ready times? include the init logs.

sam: on it. filed ticket CLOUD-8672, pinged infra provider. ETA unknown.

ops-bot: Action created: incident/1987654321/manual-pool-bump by raj -> provisioning 5 prewarmed GPUs (id:prewarm-1987).

raj: starting manual pool bump now. also killing stuck warmup tasks to force fresh init.

maria: lucy, after fallback flip, i'll move 30% traffic to eu-central and observe. leaving 70% in eu-west.

lucy: applying flag: `feature.route.streaming_model=fallback_quant_v2` (canary 5% -> 50% over 3m).

lucy: done. initial 5% canary shows median down to 300ms, p99 down to 1.2s for those sessions.

maria: good. increasing to 50%. queue depth stabilizing at ~220. p99 overall dropped to 2.1s. still above SLO but improving.

dmitri: do we have any customers impacted at SLA level? CCing support.

maria: kopernik-analytics and chatflow-prod are seeing increased error traces. filing CS notifications: support ticket #SUP-3456.

sam: cloud responded: seeing higher than normal container startup jitter across avail zones due to underlying hypervisor patching. they've paused rolling patches but can't retroactively speed existing starts. suggested prewarming nodes as workaround.

raj: prewarm-1987 nodes are started, model init on them is completing ~12s (much better). adding them to pool now.

maria: after manual bump and fallback, p95 ~400ms, p99 ~950ms. streaming stalls are mostly resolved. marking urgent mitigation success.

ops-bot: Note: post-mitigation monitoring initiated. 30m retention for high-resolution traces.

lucy: next steps: automated mitigations we should create: a) detect scale-up slow handshakes and proactively prewarm, b) automated fallback switch to quantized variant when p99 crosses 2s for >3m, c) tenant-based soft-rate-limits.

raj: agree. I'll open infra task to add fast-path image with prebuilt quant tables to cut init time. REF: infra/fast-image-proposal-1987.

maria: customer comms: support has sent initial notice to affected customers and is preparing an incident summary. Dmitri, can you draft one-page post-incident with timeline + actions?

dmitri: will do. drafting now. planning to include: timeline, root cause hypothesis (scale handshake + image coldstart + kv-cache cold misses), mitigations taken, follow-ups.

sam: I'll keep cloud ticket open and push for a RC on hypervisor patch rollouts. also requesting credits for customer impact window.

maria: handing off to night oncall in 25m. current state: stabilized but still monitoring. p99 ~900ms, queue depth ~90. fallback still enabled. next oncall: lucy.

lucy: ack, taking handoff. will monitor dashboards, keep fallback active for another 30m then plan gradual rollback after verification. leaving runbook notes: `runbooks/warmup-handshake-delay.md` updated.

oncall-bot: Handoff: maria -> lucy at 1987654520. Incident severity downgraded to SEV2.

maria: final note before handoff: we should schedule a postmortem tomorrow 09:30 UTC, invite infra, runtime, product, and support. tagging follow-ups for action owners: raj(prewarm-image), lucy(automated-fallback-rule), sam(cloud-escalation), dmitri(incident-postmortem).

lucy: got it. i'll kick off the postmortem invite and collect logs.

maria: thanks team. good catch and fast coordinated mitigation. :thumbsup:
